recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s male portrait album cover featuring a clean-cut man in a red cardigan and tan polo shirt, set against a warm, off-white studio background with high-contrast serif and script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left to balance right-aligned text
Red cardigan color-matched to the primary display serif text
Black script signature providing a personal, hand-drawn counterpoint to formal typesetting
coreInvariants: Warm, slightly yellowed paper-like background tone
Soft studio lighting with gentle shadows on the face
High-waisted composition showing head and shoulders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, head and shoulders view, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright red cardigan.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves up to the red serif title, then down to the black script signature on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space on the right side for secondary text and branding.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant tomato red for the cardigan and title text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black for the signature and small logo elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to warm earth tones and primary red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and fluid cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Serif: Thin hairlines, sharp bracketed serifs, vertical stress
Script: Continuous monolinear stroke, 30-degree slant, open loops
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders in script are elongated for dynamic movement
Serif 'S' has a distinctively large bottom bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal, rigid serif title paired with an informal, energetic script signature.
graphicDevices: Small horizontal arrow logo in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast transitional serif look of the early 60s.
Mimics the energetic, hand-signed quality of the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a young man with 1960s styled hair, wearing a red cardigan over a tan polo shirt. The background is a flat, warm cream color. Soft lighting from the front-right. Leave the right side of the frame mostly empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a title in the top right using a red transitional serif font. Below it, add a signature-style name in black ink, slanted upwards at a 15-degree angle. Place a small black arrow-shaped logo in the top left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the red of the text identical to the red of the cardigan?
Is the background a warm, aged cream rather than pure white?
Does the script text look like a fluid, hand-written signature?
Is the subject positioned to the left to allow for text on the right?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern clothing items are visible
Check that the red text is legible against the cream background
Verify the signature does not overlap the subject's face
Confirm the overall tone feels like a physical printed object from 1963
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 1960s studio portrait + place off-center + match text color to clothing + add a contrasting hand-written signature in the negative space.
